title: Chart engine
description: The framework-free engine behind the React charts: createChart mounts a chart in any element, createCanvasChart draws on any 2D canvas (mini-programs, OffscreenCanvas) and createChartController computes the scene for hosts without a canvas. createShapeChart and createCanvasShapeChart do the same for the pie, donut, radar, gauge, funnel, treemap, sunburst, Sankey, chord, radial bar, bullet and calendar heatmap charts. The other families have their own engines: createTradingChart, createDepthChart / createOrderBook / createOrderBookHeatmap / createTimeAndSales, createChart3D and createGraphChart; setDefaultChartRenderer() sets the backend of every GPU chart.

choose.title: Which entry point?
choose.text: The three entry points share the same options, layout, hit testing and gestures; they differ in what they need from the host:
choose.createChart: createChart(container, options): web pages. It mounts the chart in a DOM element, draws the data with WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, renders an accessible DOM tooltip and legend, reads the theme from the CSS variables and handles wheel, pointer and keyboard input itself.
choose.createCanvasChart: createCanvasChart({ canvas, width, height, pixelRatio, options, theme }): any 2D canvas, with no DOM at all (WeChat / Taro / uni-app canvas type="2d", OffscreenCanvas, a plain <canvas>). Everything, tooltip and legend included, is drawn on the canvas; the host forwards its touch or pointer events and passes the theme as plain values. The mini-program charts are built on it.
choose.createChartController: createChartController({ options, measureText }): no canvas at all. It computes the scene (layout, ticks, legend, tooltip, highlight) and handles the gestures; scenePrimitives(scene) turns the data into a bounded list of pixel shapes for hosts that draw with views or SVG. The React Native charts are built on it.

quadrant.title: Quadrant helpers
quadrant.text: quadrantChartOptions(config) builds the engine options of a QuadrantChart for any entry point; quadrantOf(config, x, y) returns the quadrant of a data position as seen on screen (reverseX included) and quadrantCenter(config, corner) the center of a quadrant, e.g. to place a new or dropped point. quadrantGroups(config) lists the points and indices of each quadrant, quadrantCountText(showCounts, points, locale) formats a quadrant count and quadrantLabels(locale) returns the built-in texts of the accessible point layer. createQuadrantPointLayer(host, options) mounts that layer (one list of point buttons per quadrant, arrows between the points, Shift + arrows to move the focused point to the neighbouring quadrant, a live region announcing the move) in any DOM renderer; createQuadrantPointCard(host, options) mounts the point card of the matrices in any DOM renderer (one glass card for the hovered, focused or dragged point, or the selected one on boards: its dot on the point, its name, its quadrant and the actions of the host) and withQuadrantCard(options) turns off the engine tooltip, label chip and drag pill beside it; QUADRANT_CARD_LINGER_MS is how long the card stays after the pointer leaves its dot; quadrantKeyTarget(event, corner) returns the quadrant a Shift + arrow key leads to and quadrantAccessibleGroups(config, locale) the names, labels and move actions of the points for hosts without a DOM. Task boards (the QuadrantTaskBoard of every renderer) share their logic too: QUADRANT_CORNERS lists the four corners, quadrantTaskLabels(locale, overrides) returns the localized texts of the buttons and panels, newQuadrantTaskDraft / editQuadrantTaskDraft fill the add / edit panel, canSaveQuadrantTask and applyQuadrantTaskDraft check and apply it, moveQuadrantTask and removeQuadrantTask return the next list of points, selectionAfterRemove the selection after a delete, quadrantTaskDeleteText the text of the delete confirmation, QUADRANT_TASK_ICONS the paths of the add, edit and delete icons, placeQuadrantTaskPanel(anchor, panel, board) the place of the inline add / edit / delete panel next to its anchor (below it, above when there is no room below, kept inside the board) quadrantTaskColor(quadrants, corner) the color of a quadrant and quadrantTaskIconUri(kind, color) one of those icons as a base64 SVG data URI for hosts drawing it in an image (mini programs).

ChartInstance.toPixel: Converts data coordinates to pixels of the container (null before the first layout)
ChartInstance.fromPixel: Converts pixels of the container to data coordinates (null before the first layout)
ChartInstance.getRenderer: Backend in use, null until ready
ChartInstance.ready: Resolves with the backend once the first frame can be drawn
ChartInstance.refreshTheme: Reads the CSS variables again (theme changes are detected automatically)
ChartInstance.setLabelHidden: Hides the drawn label of a point while a host card names it (the other labels keep their places); null draws it again
ChartInstance.on: Subscribes to an event; returns the unsubscribe function
ChartInstance.destroy: Removes the DOM and frees the GPU resources

ChartEventMap.hover: Hovered or keyboard-focused points changed (null when cleared)
ChartEventMap.click: A point or bar was clicked
ChartEventMap.plotClick: The plot area was clicked where there is no point
ChartEventMap.zoom: The user zoomed or panned; receives the view
ChartEventMap.renderer: The backend is ready or fell back
ChartEventMap.layout: The plot area moved or was resized; receives its rectangle
ChartEventMap.dragStart: A point starts moving with the pointer (interaction.dragPoints)
ChartEventMap.dragEnd: The drag is over (after drop, or cancelled with Escape)

ChartDragEvent.x: X data coordinate under the pointer
ChartDragEvent.y: Y data coordinate under the pointer

ChartDragEndEvent.cancelled: Escape, a cancelled pointer or a release outside the chart: no drop event

CanvasChartConfig.height: Height of the canvas in CSS pixels
CanvasChartConfig.pixelRatio: Device pixel ratio (wx.getWindowInfo().pixelRatio in mini-programs, devicePixelRatio on the web)
CanvasChartConfig.options: Chart options, the same as createChart
CanvasChartConfig.theme: Colors and fonts: values of the Minerva CSS variables

CanvasChartInstance.setOptions: Replaces the options; unchanged data arrays are not processed again
CanvasChartInstance.setTheme: Replaces the theme (e.g. after a light / dark switch)

CanvasChartInstance.touchStart: Touch start: pass the touches of the event, relative to the canvas
CanvasChartInstance.touchMove: Touch move: pass the touches of the event
CanvasChartInstance.touchEnd: Touch end: pass the changedTouches of the event
CanvasChartInstance.touchCancel: Touch cancelled (e.g. by a system gesture)
CanvasChartInstance.pointerDown: Mouse, pen or finger pressed at a pixel of the chart
CanvasChartInstance.pointerMove: Pointer moved to a pixel of the chart
CanvasChartInstance.pointerUp: Pointer released at a pixel of the chart
CanvasChartInstance.zoomAt: Zooms around a pixel (factor < 1 zooms in)
CanvasChartInstance.toggleSeries: Shows or hides a series, like a legend tap
CanvasChartInstance.clearHover: Hides the tooltip and the highlight
CanvasChartInstance.getPlotRect: Plot area in CSS pixels, null before the first layout
CanvasChartInstance.toPixel: Converts data coordinates to chart pixels (null before the first layout)
CanvasChartInstance.fromPixel: Converts chart pixels to data coordinates (null before the first layout)
CanvasChartInstance.on: Subscribes to an event (every ChartEventMap event except renderer); returns the unsubscribe function
CanvasChartInstance.destroy: Stops drawing and removes the listeners

ChartCanvas.width: Width of the backing store in device pixels (set by the chart)
ChartCanvas.height: Height of the backing store in device pixels (set by the chart)
ChartCanvas.requestAnimationFrame: Frame scheduler of the canvas (mini-program canvases); globalThis.requestAnimationFrame otherwise
ChartCanvas.cancelAnimationFrame: Cancels a frame scheduled with requestAnimationFrame

ChartTouch.x: X position relative to the canvas, in CSS pixels
ChartTouch.y: Y position relative to the canvas, in CSS pixels

ChartPointerOptions.touch: Touch input: the tooltip follows the finger and stays after a tap

ChartThemeInput.variables: Values of the Minerva CSS variables (--primary-color, --text-color, --chart-series-1...), also used to resolve var(--name) colors of the options
ChartThemeInput.fontSize: Font size of the tick labels, in pixels

ChartControllerConfig.options: Chart options, the same as createChart
ChartControllerConfig.theme: Colors and fonts (Minerva variables); light defaults when omitted
ChartControllerConfig.measureText: Returns the width in pixels of a text drawn with a CSS font
ChartControllerConfig.onInvalidate: Called when the scene changed and must be drawn again

ChartController.setOptions: Replaces the options; unchanged data arrays are not processed again
ChartController.setTheme: Replaces the theme (e.g. after a light / dark switch)
ChartController.setSize: Size of the chart in CSS pixels
ChartController.getScene: What to draw: layout, ticks, legend, tooltip and highlight (null until the size is known)
ChartController.pointerDown: Mouse, pen or finger pressed at a pixel of the chart
ChartController.pointerMove: Pointer moved to a pixel of the chart
ChartController.pointerUp: Pointer released at a pixel of the chart
ChartController.zoomAt: Zooms around a pixel (factor < 1 zooms in)
ChartController.toggleSeries: Shows or hides a series, like a legend tap
ChartController.clearHover: Hides the tooltip and the highlight
ChartController.getPlotRect: Plot area in CSS pixels, null before the first layout
ChartController.toPixel: Converts data coordinates to chart pixels (null before the first layout)

ChartController.on: Subscribes to an event (every ChartEventMap event except renderer); returns the unsubscribe function

ChartPrimitiveOptions.maxDots: Most dots drawn per series; above it the dots are merged into one per occupied cell
ChartPrimitiveOptions.maxBars: Most bars drawn per series; above it bars sharing a pixel column are merged
ChartPrimitiveOptions.columnWidth: Width in pixels of the columns lines are decimated to (at most four points per column); larger values mean fewer shapes
ChartPrimitiveOptions.dotCell: Size of the cells dots are merged into (the dot size by default)

ChartLinePrimitive.seriesIndex: Index of the series in the options
ChartLinePrimitive.segments: Runs of points without gaps, as interleaved x, y pixels

ChartAreaPrimitive.seriesIndex: Index of the series in the options
ChartAreaPrimitive.segments: Runs of points without gaps, as interleaved x, y pixels
ChartAreaPrimitive.bottoms: Stacked areas: y pixel of the bottom edge under every point of segments
ChartAreaPrimitive.horizontal: Horizontal charts: the area is filled toward the left edge (baseline and bottoms are x pixels)

ChartBarPrimitive.seriesIndex: Index of the series in the options
ChartBarPrimitive.rects: Interleaved x, y, width, height of every bar, in pixels
ChartBarPrimitive.colors: CSS color of every rect (candlesticks, heatmap cells, colored bars); color otherwise
ChartBarPrimitive.opacity: Opacity of the fill (box plot boxes, translucent bars)

ChartDotPrimitive.seriesIndex: Index of the series in the options
ChartDotPrimitive.dots: Interleaved x, y, diameter of every dot, in pixels
ChartDotPrimitive.stroke: Width of a ring of the dot color around every dot, CSS pixels (hollow box plot outliers when opacity is 0)

ShapeChartInstance.setOptions: Replaces the options (animates from the previous values)
ShapeChartInstance.resize: Measures the container again (automatic with a ResizeObserver)
ShapeChartInstance.refreshTheme: Reads the CSS variables again (theme changes on <html> / <body> are detected automatically)
ShapeChartInstance.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage or radar series by index
ShapeChartInstance.on: Subscribes to hover or click; returns the unsubscribe function
ShapeChartInstance.destroy: Removes the DOM and the listeners
ShapeChartInstance.getHidden: Indexes of the hidden slices / stages / series
ShapeChartInstance.drill: Sunburst: zooms into the node at a path and emits drill
ShapeChartInstance.getDrillPath: Sunburst: names from the root to the focused node
ShapeChartInstance.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d); null until it is chosen (the first frames are drawn with Canvas2D meanwhile)

ShapeChartEventMap.hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark: index, name, value, percent, color (treemap: path); null when the pointer leaves
ShapeChartEventMap.click: The mark clicked, tapped or activated with Enter
ShapeChartEventMap.toggle: A legend item (or `toggle()`) hid or showed a slice, stage or series
ShapeChartEventMap.drill: Sunburst: the focused node changed (or would change)

PieChartOptions.type: "pie" (a donut is a pie with innerRadius)
PieChartOptions.data: Slices: name, value (negative values count as 0) and optional color
PieChartOptions.innerRadius: Inner radius as a fraction of the outer radius: 0 = pie, 0.6 = donut
PieChartOptions.startAngle: Angle of the first slice, in degrees clockwise from 12 o’clock
PieChartOptions.padAngle: Gap between the slices in pixels (pie 1, donut 2)
PieChartOptions.cornerRadius: Corner radius of the slices in pixels (pie 0, donut 4)
PieChartOptions.rose: Nightingale rose: the radius shows the value instead of the angle
PieChartOptions.labels: Slice labels: outside with leader lines (default up to 12 slices), inside or none
PieChartOptions.labelContent: What a label shows: name, value and / or percent
PieChartOptions.centerValue: Big text in the hole of a donut (e.g. the total)

RadarChartOptions.indicators: Axes, clockwise from 12 o’clock: name, optional min and max
RadarChartOptions.series: Polygons: one value per indicator, optional name, color and opacity
RadarChartOptions.levels: Number of grid rings (4 by default)
RadarChartOptions.dots: Dots on the vertices (true by default)

GaugeChartOptions.value: Value shown by the arc (clamped to min – max for the drawing)
GaugeChartOptions.min: Value at the start of the arc (0 by default)
GaugeChartOptions.max: Value at the end of the arc (100 by default)
GaugeChartOptions.label: Caption under the value
GaugeChartOptions.sweep: Total angle of the arc in degrees (240 by default)
GaugeChartOptions.thickness: Thickness of the arc as a fraction of the radius (0.16 by default)
GaugeChartOptions.bands: Colored ranges of the track ({ to, color }); the value arc takes the color of its band
GaugeChartOptions.color: Color of the value arc when there are no bands (the first palette color by default)
GaugeChartOptions.needle: Draws a needle in addition to the value arc
GaugeChartOptions.ticks: Tick labels at the ends and at the band bounds (true by default)

FunnelChartOptions.data: Stages: name, value and optional color
FunnelChartOptions.sort: Order of the stages: descending, ascending or none (data order)
FunnelChartOptions.gap: Vertical gap between the stages in pixels (4 by default)
FunnelChartOptions.conversion: Shows the conversion rate from the previous stage (true by default)
FunnelChartOptions.shape: Shape of the stages: trapezoid (narrows to the next stage) or bar (centered bars)

TreemapChartOptions.data: Nodes: leaves carry a value, parents sum their children
TreemapChartOptions.gap: Gap between the cells in pixels (2 by default)
TreemapChartOptions.headers: Draws the names of the parents above their children (true by default)

ShapeChartCommonOptions.renderer: Backend of the shapes (auto, webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d); auto skips GPUs running in software, the text is always drawn with Canvas2D above the shapes. Defaults to the global default (setDefaultChartRenderer)
ShapeChartCommonOptions.palette: Colors of the marks without color (--chart-series-1..8, then the theme colors)
ShapeChartCommonOptions.legend: Legend (position, toggle); shown by default for pie, funnel and multi-series radar charts
ShapeChartCommonOptions.tooltip: Tooltip; false disables it, render replaces its content
ShapeChartCommonOptions.format: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (compact numbers by default)
ShapeChartCommonOptions.animation: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)
ShapeChartCommonOptions.padding: Space around the drawing, in pixels
ShapeChartCommonOptions.percentFormat: Formats the shares (labels, tooltip); one decimal by default
ShapeChartCommonOptions.locale: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French. Defaults to the page language (`<html lang>`), then the browser language
ShapeChartCommonOptions.texts: Replaces built-in texts of the locale (tooltip rows such as `value`, `share`, `conversion`, accessible names such as `pieChart`, the `noData` placeholder); `{name}`, `{label}` and `{index}` are replaced
ShapeChartCommonOptions.hidden: Indexes of the hidden slices / stages / series (controlled: legend clicks only emit `toggle`)

CanvasShapeChartConfig.height: Height of the canvas in CSS pixels
CanvasShapeChartConfig.pixelRatio: Device pixel ratio (wx.getWindowInfo().pixelRatio in mini-programs, devicePixelRatio on the web); 1 by default
